answer: Because the timing is published against the pearl challenge, the beacon audit can replay the willow history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 127 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 3548 identities would post 3928 proofs and burn roughly 12 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
